status.explain.available: This feature is implemented and tested on console.
status.explain.limited: This feature works with limitations. The reason is shown in the module.

module.home.planned:
- Home page with all sections
- System status at a glance
module.games.planned:
- Detect installed games (read-only)

- Favorites, search, filter, sorting

module.cheats.planned:
- Scan GoldHEN cheat files (json/shn/mc4)
- Search by name, title ID, region
- Version check with warning
- Categories, favorites, history
- Import/export, offline pack from USB
- Download only from the official source
module.themes.planned:
- At least 20 themes
- Preview, favorites, random switch
- Custom colors, backgrounds, sounds
- Import/export via USB
module.goldhen.planned:
- GoldHEN detection (read-only)
- Firmware and version check
- Plugin and cheat folder status
- Notes on incompatibility
module.system.planned:
- Firmware, storage, uptime
- Running application, network status
- Values that cannot be read are shown as such
module.files.planned:
- Directories and file info
- Copy, move, rename
- Delete only after confirmation
- Storage usage
module.network.planned:
- Connection status and IP address
- Secure HTTPS downloads
- Downloads only when enabled in settings
module.homebrew.planned:
- List installed homebrew apps
- Show version and title ID
module.settings.planned:
- Language, theme, animations
- Controller settings
- Reset
module.backup.planned:
- Back up dashboard data

- Overview of all feature statuses

module.games.note: Read-only: games are never launched, copied or modified.
module.cheats.note: Toggling cheats in-game is done in the GoldHEN cheat menu.
module.goldhen.note: Read-only: GoldHEN is never modified, patched or updated.
module.files.note: All writes go through the path guard. System folders are locked.
module.update.note: For the dashboard itself only, never for GoldHEN.
backup.restoreConfirm: All checksums are verified first. The current state is backed up automatically. Then the files are written back.
cheats.downloadHelp: Not available yet. GoldHEN has its own cheat downloader (GoldHEN menu).
cheats.howTo: To enable in-game: open the GoldHEN cheat menu (long SHARE or double PS, depending on GoldHEN settings) and toggle with ✕. This dashboard manages the files but does not toggle cheats in a running game.
cheats.mc4Note: MC4 files are encrypted. Only GoldHEN shows the cheat names in-game.
cheats.msg.contentMismatch: Note: title ID or version inside the file differ from the file name.
cheats.msg.multiFormat: This version also exists in another format – GoldHEN uses only one format per game version.
cheats.msg.notInstalled: The game is not installed. Compatibility cannot be checked.
cheats.msg.ok: Title ID and game version match exactly.
cheats.msg.version: A different game version is installed – cheats will probably not work or misbehave.
cheats.none: No cheat files found. Put files into /data/GoldHEN/cheats, import them from USB or use the cheat downloader in the GoldHEN menu.
cheats.searchHelp: Game name, title ID or region (US, EU, JP, ASIA)
diag.controlsText: ✕ open · ○ back · L1/R1 switch section · △ favourite · □ filter · OPTIONS menu · D-pad/left stick move · left/right in lists: page
diag.sub: Status of all sections, log and help
files.deleteConfirm: Really delete? This cannot be undone.
files.sub: Choose a start folder. System areas are write-protected.
games.readOnly: Display only: this dashboard never launches, copies or modifies games.
games.sourceNote: Source: /user/app and /system_data/priv/appmeta/<ID>/param.sfo. Version = higher of APP_VER and VERSION.
goldhen.readOnly: Read-only: this dashboard never modifies, patches or updates GoldHEN. Updates are only available from the developer SiSTRo (Ko-fi).
goldhen.sub: Status, cheat folders and plugins – read-only
import.confirm: The file will be copied into the GoldHEN cheat folder:
import.confirmReplace: A file with this name already exists. It is saved to the dashboard backups first and then replaced:
import.insertUsb: Please connect a USB drive with cheat files.
import.nothing: No valid cheat files found (name: TITLEID_VERSION.json/.shn/.mc4).
kbd.sub: Enter game name, title ID or region
menu.title: Options
network.ftpHelp: You can transfer files via FTP: GoldHEN runs an FTP server on port 2121. On a Mac connect e.g. with Cyberduck or FileZilla.
network.limits: Shown are the connection details reported by the system (NetCtl). Downloads (cheat database, updates) need a verified HTTPS client and will follow in a later version.
system.sub: Values reported by the system – unavailable values are marked
update.goldhenNote: GoldHEN updates are separate and are never installed by this dashboard. Check firmware support with the developer before updating GoldHEN.
update.manual: How to update: 1) Press ✕ here (config backup). 2) Put the new PKG from GitHub Releases (github.com/Ostlertekker/ostlertekkers-ps4-hen-ultimate) on the USB drive. 3) Install via Package Installer – settings are kept.
update.sub: For this dashboard only – never for GoldHEN
